title: Pi (π)
subtitle: Transcendental constant · Geometry
summary: Ratio of circumference to diameter of any circle.
detail:
\[ \pi = 3.14159265358979\ldots \]

Transcendental (Lindemann, 1882), hence not constructible. Appears in the area of a circle (\(A=\pi r^2\)), the volume of a sphere (\(V=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)), the Gaussian integral (\(\int e^{-x^2}dx=\sqrt{\pi}\)), and the Basel problem (\(\sum 1/n^2=\pi^2/6\)). Known to over 100 trillion decimal digits.
